panels.title: RPM по урлам (топ-10)
panels.description: Запросы в минуту к каждому урлу по журналу Caddy (идентификаторы в путях заменены на :id).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, path, SUM(value) AS rpm FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND path IN (SELECT path FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY ts, path ORDER BY ts
targets.queryText: SELECT ts / 1000 AS time, path, SUM(value) AS rpm FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND path IN (SELECT path FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY path ORDER BY SUM(value) DESC LIMIT 10) GROUP BY ts, path ORDER BY ts

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT path AS "Урл", SUM(value) AS "Запросов", ROUND(SUM(value) * 60000.0 / MAX(1, $__to - $__from), 2) AS "Средний RPM" FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY path ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50
targets.queryText: SELECT path AS "Урл", SUM(value) AS "Запросов", ROUND(SUM(value) * 60000.0 / MAX(1, $__to - $__from), 2) AS "Средний RPM" FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND name = 'http' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY path ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Уникальные посетители в день
panels.description: Браузер = посетитель: обезличенный id в localStorage (planner) или по входу в комнату (retrocine).

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts + 10800000) / 86400000) * 86400 - 10800 AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS "посетители" FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND uid IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.queryText: SELECT ((ts + 10800000) / 86400000) * 86400 - 10800 AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT uid) AS "посетители" FROM events WHERE app = '$app' AND uid IS NOT NULL AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE json_extract(props, '$.mode') WHEN 'kart' THEN 'карт' WHEN 'bike' THEN 'BMX' WHEN 'skateboard' THEN 'скейт' WHEN 'scooter' THEN 'самокат' WHEN 'sled' THEN 'санки' WHEN 'zipline' THEN 'троллей' ELSE json_extract(props, '$.mode') END AS "на чём", ROUND(SUM(value) / 1000.0, 2) AS "км" FROM events WHERE app = 'retrocine' AND name = 'distance' AND json_extract(props, '$.mode') <> 'foot' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Километры в день: пешком и на колёсах

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ((ts + 10800000) / 86400000) * 86400 - 10800 AS time, CASE json_extract(props, '$.mode') WHEN 'foot' THEN 'пешком' ELSE 'на колёсах' END AS mode, SUM(value) / 1000.0 AS km FROM events WHERE app = 'retrocine' AND name = 'distance' AND ts BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
